description:
Deliverables:
- Implement the disconnected-island execution mode on top of the lease backend.
- Allow one logical owner across separate Erlang islands.
- Reject stale lease holders.
- Define heal and reacquire behavior after partitions and reconnects.

Acceptance:
- Two-island acceptance covers acquire, renew, failover on lease expiry, stale lease rejection, and reconnect without same-key dual ownership.
title: Implement disconnected-island singleton runtime
